name: Ron Totosz
summary: Larry's bunk mate and his most constant companion in the photographs: "Ron Tototz. He's polish and was with me during the shooting incident in the bathroom. Ron was my bunk mate." "Ron was from Des Moines, Iowa." He is with Larry from the first weeks at Nha Trang (VN-0025, with Parr) and on the beach there (VN-0021, VN-0022), at the French pool in Cholon (VN-0004, VN-0005), in their quarters (VN-0001, VN-0002, VN-0003), and outside hooch T 123 holding Sarge the monkey, which he hated (VN-0017). In Saigon they always ate at the Mỹ Cảnh floating restaurant ("Ronnie Tototz would be sitting across from me"), and most of the time rode with the same taxi driver, VC Charlie. When something needed repair, a radio for instance, "they would get ahold of La Franceaous or Ron Tototz." Identified in August 2026 as Ronald E. Totosz of Des Moines, Iowa (1941–2004).
researchNotes: Identified 2026-08-16 (issue #58) as Ronald E. Totosz, the only Ronald of this rare Polish surname found anywhere in the country, in the city Larry named. Documented: his U.S. Army enlistment, at 21, reported in the Des Moines Register of 2 November 1962, a three-year term that brackets Larry's tour; his death on 12 August 2004, with an obituary in the Register of 18 August 2004. His death was earlier than Larry's "about ten years ago" (giscus-stories-c18033934), a familiar compression of time in long recollection; how and whether Larry hears the date is the family's decision. Still open: a document placing him in Vietnam and in Larry's unit (morning reports via NPRC). Search record: research/people/ron-tototz-search.md. 2026-09-14: private details (addresses, family members, resting place) were moved out of this record and the search file to private/people/ron-tototz-private.md, after research/site-audit-2026-09-14.md. 2026-09-12: placed by Larry to the left of Kahn in the guitar session (VN-0003), and in the same group in VN-0007 and VN-0008; at VN-0002, "Everyone in the hooch is pretty much E-4's." 2026-09-13 (data/recollections/2026-09-13-phone-la-franceaous.json, transcribed): the first job anyone has given Ron, repairing radios. 2026-09-15, on his son's decision: the display name is the documented spelling, Totosz, with Larry's "Tototz" kept as an alias and in every recollection as given; the slug stays ron-tototz. The full name "Ronald E. Totosz" was taken out of the rendered aliases. 2026-09-15, on his son's decision (no spelling notes on public pages): the rendered aliases were trimmed; removed from display, kept here: "Tototz (as Larry says it)".
